statement: Na Yin ('received sound') assigns each Stem-Branch pillar one of 30 classical elemental-phase names — an older, sound-derived elemental reading distinct from the pillar stem's own element, traditionally read as a subtler undertone to the chart's more direct Five-Element analysis.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard BaZi literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
